pages.notes: Player who can use Skill Check (donator). A staff member who cannot use Skill Check gets 'Skills' (open:skills, accent e) in that slot instead; a plain player gets no 6th tile (Character Services then sits alone on the left of the last row). pages.title: Legacy Mechanics
lines: &7Everyone gets the same three goals. Progress counts from the start of the week.
pages.codeToday: Code already builds this page (openGoals) but the top is two lines: header '&6&lWeekly goals' then labelValue '&7Resets in &f3d 4h'. Everything else (explanation line, a header + progress-bar line per goal, 'Go to X' buttons two-up, no rewards) matches the mock.
pages.notes: Target header uses a middle dot; UltraStyle.wireText rewrites U+00B7 to '-', so on the wire it reads 'Weekly goals - resets in 3d 4h' (and header() makes the whole line bold gold, including the timer). Goals are picked per week from a pool of 7 (one per system); other possible buttons: 'Go to Sparring' (go:spar|home), 'Go to Rival' (go:rival|home), 'Go to Tiers' (go:difficulty|tiers), 'Go to More' (go:hub|more, for the meditation goal: a vague label, the meditation info is on More but the label does not say so). Longest goal title 'Meditate 20 minutes near another player'. A finished goal's progress line is &a green. Go-to buttons carry no system palette, unlike hub tiles. No Back footer (hub tab).

pages.title: My colors
lines: &fType a color like #e23b3b, or tap a wheel.
&fApply saves them and every menu uses them.
&7From copies a skin's colors into the fields. Reset fills in the defaults.
&7Nothing changes until you tap Apply. It is free.
&cText: That doesn't look like a color - use 6 hex digits, like #e23b3b
&7Text color adjusted so it stays readable (now #f4ecd8).
pages.notes: LM client 4.7.66+ with color wheels; worst case shows the error line (a field that is not 6 hex digits, here Text = 'zz12') and the readability note. Each tone row: an inert dim label button 96px, a 96px hex field (max 9 chars, color preview swatch), a 44px color wheel. The 44px wheels are taller than the 24px row step, so in the legacy grid they overlap the next rows unless the client draws them as a pop-out. Without wheels: same rows minus the wheel cell, and line 1 reads 'Type a color like #e23b3b.' A client that cannot edit gets only two lines ('Editing your colors needs the Legacy Mechanics client, 4.7.66 or newer.' / 'You can still wear Custom with the colors you saved, and any other skin.') and the Back footer. Every click sends all five fields (bindInputsToButtons), Enter clicks Apply. Message after From/Reset: '&fFilled in Namek Serenity's colors. Tap Apply to use them.' After a save: '&fSaved. Every menu now uses your colors.' 'Preview' is a locked dim button (dead on KaiPath). Labels 'From Obsidian' and 'From Beerus' are shortened names of 'Obsidian & Gold' and 'Beerus Destruction'.

mock.why: openCustom: a 44 px colour wheel on each of the five colour rows makes every row 44 px tall (587 px page, mostly gaps). Target: the five rows are label | field (two columns), and ONE wheel under them fills the field you tapped last.

pages.title: Staff Admin
Staff Admin
lines: Reload Legacy Mechanics config from disk.
Open Progression panel or Config editor.

pages.notes: No body lines: a paged_book widget (2 pages, x16 y50 w306 h88) sits at the top and setRow puts the first button row at y144. 'Reload Legacy Mechanics config' is 30 chars in a 150px button (about 22 fit), so it gets clipped; it should be buttonWide. Reload has no warning about what it does to live players and runs on one click. activeTab('home') with no tabs. Footer: Staff Admin's registry parent is hub|main, so it is treated as a system Home: one 'Back to main menu' on the right (bridge), even though the Staff Admin tile lives on More; an LM nav client shows 'Back to More' from history. Pure repeat skipped: admin 'main' page id opens the same layout.

pages.title: Skill Check
pages.notes: Body-only page, no buttons besides the Back footer (one 'Back to main menu' on the right: system Home). 14 lines, the band caps at BODY_MIN_H and the rest scroll. Skill names 'Heal Red' and 'IT' are abbreviations a player will not recognise (Healing Reduction, Instant Transmission). Potential shows raw '340/1300' with no label for what the numbers are (points to next level). Failure state: one '&8No skills listed. Ask staff to turn skill unlock on.' line. PageRegistry registers skillcheck|main with staff(), so donators who can use Skill Check never find it in hub search.

pages.title: Difficulty > Player Scaling

panel.note: requests 1920x1080 panel, lockPanel, center(false), margin 0, fillScreen(426x240 design box), buttonHeight 13, lineGap 2, bodyPad 4

pages.source: UltraConfigScreens.java openEditor section branch; paintField (469); paintControl NUMBER (640)
pages.notes: One number field per page (a number block is 75px of the 104px budget, so it never shares). Field block: name (dim, 130px) + value indicator (116px, confirm when changed); description (166px, Undo beside it when changed); 'Accepts:' line; text field; Apply / - / + (7px gaps). Name slot fits ~19 chars so '* Team Bonus Per Member' clips. 'Now 0.15 - default 0.1' does not fit 108px so the default is dropped, leaving 'Now 0.15'. Description is cut on a word by oneLine() and then fits, so it shows NO ellipsis: 'Extra damage scaling for each' reads as a complete sentence. All the text rows are do:refresh buttons (a click reloads the page), not inert nav:none labels. Rejected entry: the Accepts row becomes a danger row with the hint. Sample field name/description are representative (teamBonusPerMember is a Player Scaling leaf); the real text comes from ConfigFieldHelp. Footer: registry parent config|edit:difficulty:0: -> 'Back to Difficulty settings' + 'Main menu'. Enum fields use the same block with Apply / Next (confirm) / Options instead of Apply / - / +; list/map fields get a field, Apply 100px + 'Open <value>' 100px; text fields a full-width Apply.

mock.why: the hint "Search by name" (80 px) is cut in the 78 px field; "Extra damage scaling for each" (156 px) does not fit its 166 px row inside the 8 px padding: oneLine trims by the 6 px estimate, not real widths

Use threeUpGap (7 px) as the number and enum rows do: x 164 / 251 / 338. pages.title: Review changes

rows.label: Not changed from the editor before.

panel.note: requests 1920x1080 panel, lockPanel, center(false), margin 0, fillScreen(426x240 design box), buttonHeight 13, lineGap 2, bodyPad 4

pages.notes: 2 changes per page (3 rows each, budget 169-65). Row 3 of each change: 'Last changed by <name> on <when>.' - with a 16-char name oneLine() cuts at the word before the limit and the result fits, so the date is silently dropped with no ellipsis ('Last changed by xXDragonSlayerXx'). A change someone else saved meanwhile shows its title row as danger: '<name> changed this since: <setting>'. Conflict variant adds two rows under the summary: danger '<actor> saved <modules> at <when> after you started.' and confirm 'Reload and reapply my changes' (full width); 'Also editing: a, b' adds a dim row. No changes: 'No unsaved changes.' + 'Nothing is written until you confirm a change.' or the last save report. Discard all asks for a second click within 10s (warning arrives as a chat/toast line after the first click, not on the button). BUG: openReview computes 'back' (the editor page the staff member came from) and never uses it; spec.back() falls to the registry parent (review:** -> admin|admin), so on a bridge client Back skips the editor and lands on Staff Admin. 'Reload disk' is jargon and gives no warning about what it does to unsaved edits. 'Now 0.1 -> 0.15' uses raw config values (true/false become ON/OFF).

pages.notes: Line 2 is ONE line() call holding a 9-line status dump joined with \n (ProgressionSystem.statusSummary). It is full of raw config ids and abbreviations (master=, pot=, med=, yard=, dot=, apothic=, endportal=, statcheck=) - breaks the no-raw-IDs player-text rule even for a staff page. Body-only page: no buttons, just the tabs and the footer. PageRegistry registers progression|main/boosts/coins/boosts_tp/boosts_mastery with p() (public), not staff(), so non-staff players see Progression, Boosts, Coins, TP Boost and Mastery Boost in hub search; clicking bounces them to the hub. Registry parent is hub|main although the panel is reached from Staff Admin, so Back says 'Back to main menu'.
